kill_normal.text: Sit down! One down, push up!
Got him! Don't let them rotate!

kill_headshot.text: Clean headshot, clean! Who is next?!
One tapped! Don't ever peek me!

kill_knife.text: HAHA! Sliced him up! That is embarrassing!

kill_multikill.text: I am on fire today! Two down, let's go!
They cannot touch me! Push B, wipe them all!

death_normal.text: Ugh, I'm down! He was waiting right there!
Man! Watch out on the right!

death_camped.text: Are you serious?! Camping in the darkest corner like a coward!
Bro! Who sits there with a shotgun?! Unbelievable!
Total rat gameplay! Watch that corner!

death_awp.text: AWP holding the long angle! Don't peek him!
One shot through the smoke, unbelievable!

round_start_normal.text: Alright, full buy! Let's smash them this round!
Stick together, fast push, don't stop!

round_start_eco.text: Save round. Deagle and armor, make every bullet count.
Eco round! Just hunt for weapon drops!

round_win_easy.text: Too easy! They are literally shaking!

round_win_close.text: YES! My heart was pounding, great round!
That was way too close! Good job everyone!

round_loss.text: Damn it! We threw that away, refocus!
Shake it off, we take the next one easily.

round_loss_tilted.text: Come on guys, what are we doing?! Stop giving away free kills!
I am so done with these mistakes! Play together!

bomb_planted.text: Bomb is down! Move, move, we need to retake now!
They planted! Check your angles, flash in together!

bomb_defusing.text: Hold them off, stick the defuse!

bomb_defused.text: Defused! That was clutch, let's go!

clutch_situation.text: You got this bro, keep quiet, listen to footsteps.
Take your time, one by one. You're better than them.

player_clutch_won.text: NO WAY! YOU ACTUALLY CLUTCHED THAT! WHAT A GOD!
UNREAL! Best play I've seen all week!

friendly_fire.text: Bro, watch your fire! I'm on your team!
Hey! Shoot the guys with the AKs, not me!

order_follow.text: On your six! Lead the way!

order_rush.text: RUSH B! NO BRAKES! GO GO GO!

order_hold.text: Holding this angle, they won't pass.
Locked down here, waiting for them.

kill_normal.text: Sent him to spectator mode! Easy!
Did he forget to turn his monitor on? Got him!
Dropped! Thank you for the donation!

kill_headshot.text: Ding! Right on the helmet! Beautiful!

kill_knife.text: HE JUST GOT BUTTERED! Someone clip that!
Ninja backstab! You love to see it!

kill_multikill.text: Call me the garbage man, cleaning up the whole site!
Two kills in two seconds! I might be a pro after all!

death_normal.text: Okay, my mouse definitely lagged there. He's at A!
Ouch! Someone avenge my handsome face!
I tripped! Okay fine, he shot me. One low on health!

death_camped.text: Bro is paying rent in that corner! Be careful there!
He literally took a nap behind that box, watch out!

death_awp.text: Got deleted from the server! Don't peek that sniper!
Yep, that was an AWP. I felt that in real life.

round_start_normal.text: Time to click heads and take names, let's roll!
Remember boys: shoot the bad guys, don't get shot.

round_start_eco.text: Eco round! P90 rush or bust, let's pray to the CS gods!
I have four dollars and a flashbang. Watch this play!

round_win_easy.text: Were those bots or actual people? Easiest round of my life!
Flawless victory! Do they even practice?

round_win_close.text: Phew! My hands are actually sweating, nice work!
Never doubted us for a single millisecond!

round_loss.text: Well... that didn't go according to plan, haha!
Next round is our comeback arc, trust the process!

round_loss_tilted.text: Okay guys, the joke isn't funny anymore, let's actually win one!
Vikram, don't break your desk bro, we got this next round!

bomb_planted.text: Clock is ticking! Retake time, don't step on Legos!
Bomb planted! Let's crash their party!

bomb_defusing.text: Cutting the blue wire... or was it red?! Covering defuse!
Stick it, I'll bodyblock the bullets!

bomb_defused.text: Bomb defused! Where is my medal?!

clutch_situation.text: All on you hero! Make them look silly!
He has no idea where you are, easy 1v1.

player_clutch_won.text: HOLY SMOKES! THAT WAS DISGUSTING! Teach me your ways!
I am bowing down! Absolute legend!

friendly_fire.text: Ow! Hey, friendly fire isn't so friendly, dude!
Are my colors confusing you?! I'm with you!

order_follow.text: I am your personal bodyguard now, let's go!

order_hold.text: Camping like a pro, nobody gets past me.

order_save.text: Tactical retreat! My weapon is too pretty to lose.
Saving mode engaged, see you next round!

kill_headshot.text: Clean shot. One less angle to clear.

kill_multikill.text: Two hostiles neutralized. Site is opening up.

death_normal.text: Down at connector. Hostile tagged for 50.
Crossfire got me. Watch catwalk, two remaining.
Eliminated. Killer is moving towards bomb site.

death_camped.text: Hostile holding deep corner with shotgun. Check tight angles.
Unorthodox spot behind the barrels. Flash before clearing.

death_awp.text: Sniper active down Long. Smoke cross recommended.
AWP locked on middle. Do not dry peek.

round_start_normal.text: Standard setup. Marcus watching mid. Good luck team.
Full buy secured. Trade frags effectively.

round_start_eco.text: Eco round. Play for weapon drops, do not overcommit.
Save credits. Crossfire with pistols only.

round_win_close.text: Good composure under pressure. Solid round.
Excellent team trades at the end. Well done.

round_loss.text: Mistakes were made on rotations. Reset mental.
Economies will balance. Focus on next round positioning.

round_loss_tilted.text: We need communication. Call your flashes and hold trades.
Take a breath. Stick to fundamental angles.

bomb_planted.text: Bomb planted. 45 seconds on timer. Synchronize entry.
Retake initiated. Flash high, check default first.

clutch_situation.text: You have the advantage. He has to defuse. Play time.
Footsteps right. Hold crosshair head height.

player_clutch_won.text: Outstanding clutch. Ice in your veins.
Exceptional patience on that angle. Well played.

friendly_fire.text: Check targets. You clipped my armor.

order_follow.text: On your flank. Ready to trade.

order_save.text: Saving weapon. Falling back to spawn.
Conceding the round to preserve economy.

kill_normal.text: I got him! Did you see that?! I got him!
Yes! One enemy down! P90 never fails!
Down! Oh man, my hands are shaking!

kill_headshot.text: Whoa! I got a headshot! Pure skill, or pure luck!
Headshot! Wow, that sounded so satisfying!

kill_knife.text: I knifed him! I actually knifed him! OMG!
Knife kill! I feel like a real ninja now!

kill_multikill.text: TWO KILLS! GUYS, I GOT TWO KILLS! WE ARE WINNING THIS!
I'm helping! Look at the scoreboard!

death_normal.text: Ah! He shot me from the tunnel, I'm sorry guys!
Ouch! He was so fast! Be careful there!
I panicked and missed my spray, sorry team!

death_camped.text: He was hiding in the corner! He scared the life out of me!
Why was he standing there?! Watch out!

death_awp.text: I peeked and instantly vaporized! It's an AWP!
Big sniper shot, don't go that way!

round_start_normal.text: Okay, I bought armor and an SMG! I'm ready!
Should I follow you? I'll follow you!

round_start_eco.text: I only have 300 dollars... should I buy a flashbang?
Eco round! I'll try my best with the Glock!

round_win_easy.text: We won! That was amazing, you guys are so good!

round_win_close.text: Oh my gosh, I was holding my breath the whole time!
We actually won that?! Best team ever!

round_loss.text: Aw man, that's okay, we can still win the match!
My bad guys, I'll do better next round!

round_loss_tilted.text: Please don't be mad guys, we can turn this around!
Don't give up! I believe in us!

bomb_planted.text: Oh no, the bomb is planted! Where do I go?!
Beeping is fast! We need to defuse right now!

bomb_defusing.text: I have a defuse kit! Defusing now, protect me please!

bomb_defused.text: I defused it! WE SAVED THE DAY!
Phew! Wire cut! We did it!

clutch_situation.text: You can do this! We are all watching you!
He's low HP, just one burst!

player_clutch_won.text: HOW DID YOU DO THAT?! YOU ARE A MONSTER! WOW!
THAT WAS INCREDIBLE! I want to play like you one day!

friendly_fire.text: SORRY! SORRY! I didn't mean to shoot you! Total accident!
Ah! Don't shoot me back, I thought you were an enemy!

order_follow.text: Right behind you! Covering your back!
I'm on you! Don't leave me alone!

order_rush.text: Following the push! Spraying and praying!

order_hold.text: Holding right here, staring at the door!

order_save.text: Okay, running away to save my gun!
